# DonorDock vs Network for Good Comparison

## **DonorDock**

### Best For
- Small to mid-sized nonprofits
- Organizations wanting simple, affordable donor management
- Churches and faith-based organizations

### Key Features
- Donor database & contact management
- Online donation forms
- Email marketing
- Task management & follow-ups
- Reporting and analytics
- Mobile app

### Pricing
- **Free plan** available (up to 500 contacts)
- Paid plans start around **$59-99/month**
- More affordable for smaller organizations

### Pros
- User-friendly interface
- Good customer support
- Affordable pricing structure
- All-in-one solution

### Cons
- Fewer integrations than competitors
- Less robust for larger organizations
- Limited advanced features

---

## **Network for Good**

### Best For
- Small to medium nonprofits
- Organizations needing fundraising coaching/support
- Groups wanting comprehensive fundraising tools

### Key Features
- Donor management (CRM)
- Online fundraising pages
- Peer-to-peer fundraising
- Email marketing
- Donation processing
- Fundraising coaching & resources
- Reporting & analytics

### Pricing
- Starts around **$99-249/month** (depending on features)
- **Transaction fees** apply (typically 3-5%)
- Platform fee on donations

### Pros
- Comprehensive fundraising platform
- Educational resources & support
- Strong email marketing tools
- Established reputation

### Cons
- Higher cost overall
- Transaction fees can add up
- Steeper learning curve
- Some users report customer service issues

---

## **Quick Decision Guide**

**Choose DonorDock if:**
- You have a limited budget
- You want simplicity over advanced features
- You're a smaller organization (<1,000 donors)

**Choose Network for Good if:**
- You need comprehensive fundraising tools
- You value coaching and educational resources
- You have more complex fundraising needs
- Budget allows for higher monthly costs

Both platforms offer solid donor management, so your choice largely depends on budget and feature requirements.
